videoSection.title: What Is The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?
videoSection.subtitle: The luxury hotel brand's entry into yacht-style cruising — combining all-suite accommodations, private terraces, personalized service, and destination-focused itineraries.
videoSection.videoText: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is designed around privacy, personalized service, ocean views, fine dining and access to intimate ports that large cruise ships cannot reach.
specialties: All-suite accommodations with private ocean-view terraces
Personalized Suite Ambassador service for every guest
Intimate passenger counts (298 to 452 guests max)
Multiple fine dining venues & included premium beverages
Signature Marina with direct ocean water sports access

whyAttention.title: Is The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Worth It?
whyAttention.quote: I want to cruise, but I don't want to feel like I'm on a cruise ship.
whyAttention.author: Angela Hughes, CEO of Trips & Ships Luxury Travel
whyAttention.body: For the right traveler, yes. The experience is compelling for those seeking small-ship intimacy, private terraces, and boutique hotel atmosphere. Choose it because its style of travel matches how you want to spend your vacation.

items.title: Evrima
items.subtitle: Original Yacht | 149 Suites | 298 Guests
items.description: Best for travelers who want the most intimate experience in the collection. With 149 suites and 298 maximum guests, Evrima offers the strongest argument for smaller-scale luxury cruising.

faqs.question: 1. Is The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection worth it?
faqs.answer: For travelers who value intimate yacht-style cruising, all-suite accommodations, private terraces, personalized service and sophisticated surroundings, it can be worth the premium. It is less suitable for travelers seeking large-ship entertainment or the lowest possible luxury-cruise fare.

faqs.question: 2. How much does The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing varies significantly by yacht, itinerary, sailing date, suite category and availability. Luxury travelers should compare the total fare and included services rather than relying on a single advertised starting price.

faqs.question: 3. Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: The collection operates with an all-inclusive approach that includes suite accommodation, meals, selected beverages, Wi-Fi, entertainment, water sports and onboard gratuities. Certain premium experiences and services may cost extra.

faqs.question: 4. Which Ritz-Carlton yacht is best?
faqs.answer: Evrima is the smallest and most intimate. Ilma offers a larger version of the yacht concept, while Luminara is the newest yacht and offers its own design and itinerary advantages. The best yacht ultimately depends on the itinerary and traveler preferences.

faqs.question: 5. What is the difference between Evrima, Ilma and Luminara?
faqs.answer: The main differences are size, suite count, guest capacity, onboard spaces and itineraries. Evrima accommodates up to 298 guests, while Ilma and Luminara accommodate up to 448 and 452 guests respectively.

faqs.question: 6. Does every Ritz-Carlton yacht suite have a private terrace?
faqs.answer: Private terraces are a defining feature of the collection's all-suite accommodation concept. Travelers should confirm the exact configuration of their selected suite before booking.

faqs.question: 7. Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for first-time cruisers?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be particularly appealing to travelers who normally avoid cruising because they dislike crowds, large ships, buffets and highly programmed vacations.

faqs.question: 8. Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for couples?
faqs.answer: Yes. The intimate atmosphere, suites, private terraces, dining and destination-focused itineraries make the collection especially attractive for couples, anniversaries and milestone trips.

faqs.question: 9. Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection have entertainment?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the experience is intentionally more intimate than that of a large cruise ship. Travelers should expect curated entertainment and enrichment rather than huge theaters, casinos and large-scale productions.

faqs.question: 10. Are gratuities included on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?
faqs.answer: Onboard gratuities are included in the fare according to the collection's current all-inclusive offering. Travelers should confirm any exceptions for specialized services before departure.

faqs.question: 11. Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection have casinos?
faqs.answer: The collection is not designed around the traditional casino-at-sea experience. Travelers looking for casino-focused cruising should consider other cruise products.

faqs.question: 12. Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for families?
faqs.answer: It can work for families, but the best fit depends on the children's ages and expectations. Families seeking extensive water parks, children's clubs and large-scale youth programming may prefer a different cruise line.

faqs.question: 13. What destinations does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection visit?
faqs.answer: The collection operates voyages across regions including the Mediterranean, Northern Europe, Caribbean, Asia-Pacific, Alaska and the South Pacific. Exact destinations vary by yacht and season.

faqs.question: 14. How does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection compare with Regent or Silversea?
faqs.answer: All three operate in the luxury-cruise space, but the experiences differ. Ritz-Carlton emphasizes yacht-style design, hotel-inspired service and an intimate atmosphere. Regent and Silversea have different strengths across itineraries, ships, inclusions and onboard experiences.

faqs.question: 15. Should I book Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection directly or use a luxury travel advisor?
faqs.answer: A luxury travel advisor can help compare yachts, suite categories, itineraries, pre- and post-cruise arrangements and competing luxury products. This can be particularly valuable when the trip represents a significant investment or includes complex international arrangements.
